tagline.en_US: Tvheadend works as a proxy server: is a TV streaming server and recorder for Linux, FreeBSD and Android supporting DVB-S, DVB-S2, DVB-C, DVB-T, ATSC, ISDB-T, IPTV, SAT>IP and HDHomeRun as input sources.

description.en_US: Tvheadend is a TV streaming server and recorder that acts as a proxy server for broadcast and network sources. It supports input sources including DVB-S, DVB-T, ATSC, IPTV, SAT>IP, and HDHomeRun. The server provides live streaming via HTTP, HTSP, and SAT>IP to media players, alongside scheduled recording capabilities and support for multiple electronic program guide sources.

tips: If the setup wizard does not pop up at first login, it can be launched from Configuration --> General --> Base by clicking Start Wizard.
